part.name: ergonomic computer mouse housing with scroll wheel

part_functions.name: handheld_pointing_device_body
part_functions.function: Provides an ergonomic hand-supporting enclosure for a computer mouse.

part_functions.name: scroll_input_interface
part_functions.function: Supports an exposed rotary wheel near the upper front region for finger-operated scrolling.

part_functions.name: internal_component_enclosure
part_functions.function: Forms the external volume around the space normally occupied by sensing, switching, and electronic components.

section_functions.name: enclose_and_support
section_functions.function: The continuous rounded body encloses the device volume, supports the user's palm, and provides the structural foundation for the wheel interface.

section_functions.name: left_right_structural_symmetry
section_functions.function: The opposed left and right side surfaces are approximately symmetric about the longitudinal center plane and join the top, bottom, front, and rear surfaces into a closed body.

section_functions.name: wheel_mount_support_relationship
section_functions.function: The housing is integral with and supports the central wheel-mount geometry near the top-front area.

feature_functions.name: ergonomic_grip_surface
feature_functions.function: Provides a smooth convex top and rounded side walls that distribute palm and finger contact loads.

feature_functions.name: protective_envelope
feature_functions.function: Forms a closed, impact-resistant external envelope around the mouse interior.

feature_functions.name: surface_continuity
feature_functions.function: Adjacent B-spline patches blend the front cap, top, sides, rear cap, and bottom into the continuous housing volume.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Rounded front end-cap surface at the positive-Z end, adjacent to the top, bottom, and both side surfaces.
Broad convex upper palm-support surface containing the central boundary associated with the wheel-mount interface.
Rounded left longitudinal side surface connecting the top, bottom, front, and rear regions.
Sloped rounded rear end-cap surface at the negative-Z end.
Predominantly flat lower base surface joining the side and end surfaces.
Rounded right longitudinal side surface approximately symmetric to face 7.

section_functions.name: locate_scroll_wheel
section_functions.function: Provides an integral rectangular support and clearance region that positions the wheel near the housing centerline and constrains its lateral location.

section_functions.name: transfer_operating_load
section_functions.function: Transfers finger-generated wheel loads into the main housing through planar walls and the lower support face.

section_functions.name: alignment_relationship
section_functions.function: The opposed side walls align the scroll wheel approximately about the transverse X-axis, while the mount joins the surrounding upper housing.

features.name: Rectangular wheel support pocket and pedestal

feature_functions.name: lateral_retention
feature_functions.function: Opposed planar side walls limit transverse movement of the scroll-wheel assembly.

feature_functions.name: longitudinal_location
feature_functions.function: Front and rear planar walls locate the wheel-support region along the mouse longitudinal axis.

feature_functions.name: support_floor
feature_functions.function: The lower planar face closes and stiffens the mount while transmitting loads into the housing.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Lower rectangular floor of the wheel-support pocket at Y equals 10 mm.
Negative-X lateral wall of the slightly tilted wheel-support pocket.
Negative-Z end wall of the wheel-support pocket.
Positive-X lateral wall opposite face 0, providing the other side of the wheel location envelope.
Positive-Z end wall of the wheel-support pocket, partially bounded by the adjacent housing and wheel region.

section_functions.name: rotary_user_input
section_functions.function: Presents a rounded finger-contact member that can rotate about a transverse axis to provide scrolling input.

section_functions.name: mount_interface_relationship
section_functions.function: The wheel is centered within the housing mount and is approximately coaxial with the transverse X-axis defined by its opposed planar side faces.

section_functions.name: retention_and_clearance
section_functions.function: Its side faces provide axial boundaries while the toroidal tread surfaces protrude above the housing for access and remain clear of the mount walls.

feature_functions.name: finger_contact_tread
feature_functions.function: The two adjoining toroidal surfaces form a crowned, rounded tread for comfortable finger traction.

feature_functions.name: axial_end_boundaries
feature_functions.function: The two opposed planar circular faces terminate the wheel along its rotational axis and define its axial width.

feature_functions.name: coaxial_rotation
feature_functions.function: The tread and end faces collectively define a wheel oriented approximately along the X-axis for fore-aft finger rolling.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Negative-X planar circular end face of the scroll wheel.
Negative-X portion of the rounded toroidal wheel tread adjacent to end face 12.
Positive-X portion of the rounded toroidal wheel tread adjoining face 11 and end face 14.
Positive-X planar circular end face of the scroll wheel.
